comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Plasma-derived immune globulin for immune deficiency, made from collected plasma; different therapy area and manufacturing model from Akebia's kidney drugs.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Broad generic and injectable drug maker across many therapy areas; not a focused kidney-disease branded specialist.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Generic injectables, inhalers and diagnostic kits, including OTC products; different products and customers from kidney prescription drugs.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Industrial specialty chemicals sold to formulators; no prescription drugs or healthcare providers as customers.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Branded prescription specialty drugs for chronic disease sold through specialists and specialty pharmacies, with partners abroad; disease area differs.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Orthopedic devices and biologics sold to surgeons and clinics; not prescription drugs for kidney patients or dialysis providers.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Consumer household, personal care and vitamin products sold through mass retail; not prescription drugs.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Implantable heart valves and hemodynamic monitoring devices sold to hospitals; a device business, not a drug business.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: IV infusion devices and disposables sold to hospitals; device-focused rather than branded prescription kidney drugs.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Niche branded prescription drugs for one chronic condition, sold through wholesalers, pharmacies and treatment clinics; similar specialty model.

comps.label: C11
comps.reason: Earns royalties on respiratory drugs and sells hospital antibiotics; different therapy areas and mainly a royalty holding model.

comps.label: C12
comps.reason: Neurosurgical instruments and implants sold to surgeons; medical devices rather than prescription drugs.

comps.label: C13
comps.reason: GI drugs earned mainly as royalties from licensing partners who sell them; Akebia sells its own drugs to dialysis providers.

comps.label: C14
comps.reason: Radiopharmaceutical imaging agents and generators for diagnostic imaging; different products and customers.

comps.label: C15
comps.reason: Disposable interventional catheters and guidewires sold to hospitals; a medical device business.

comps.label: C16
comps.reason: Tissue-based skin substitutes and wound dressings applied by physicians; not prescription drugs for kidney disease.

comps.label: C17
comps.reason: Branded surgical pain injectables and a device administered in hospitals and surgery centers; different disease and channel.

comps.label: C18
comps.reason: Single niche branded oral cancer drug sold by US direct sales and specialty distributors, with licensed partners selling abroad; similar model.

comps.label: C19
comps.reason: Pneumatic compression devices for lymphedema used at home and in clinics; a device business, not prescription drugs.

comps.label: C20
comps.reason: Broad range of hospital medical devices such as catheters and surgical instruments; not prescription drugs.

comps.label: C21
comps.reason: Spine implants and bone graft products sold to spine surgeons; orthopedic devices and tissue, not drugs.
